lockMintingRights(uint256[],string,uint2.details: This is the foundation of the leverage system.      Wayne locks token IDs that DO NOT EXIST YET on-chain.      No NFT transfer occurs. The rights are purely on-chain      proof of Wayne's ability to mint those future tokens.      Face value is calculated from immutable tier floor constants:        EPIC:        315 ETH per token        SUPER RARE:   22 ETH per token        RARE:         10 ETH per token        STANDARD:      1 ETH per token      The resulting lockId is used by EWBMintingRightsVault      to borrow Circle USDC from Aave against face value × LTV.

params.expiresAt: Unix timestamp for lock expiry (0 = no expiry)
params.tokenIds: Unminted EWB token IDs to commit (max 500 per call)

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

unlockMintingRights(uint256).details: Only callable by Ballet wallet.      Should only be called after Aave debt fully repaid.      Cycle resets — same token IDs can be locked again.

BALLET_WALLET().notice: Ballet wallet — Wayne Fyffe — sole owner
